text:
jia: quick check — ran a 6h job with randomized micro-window + per-token budget clamp. hitting weird tail latencies around 99.9th. attaching config we used and a tiny profile snippet.

alex: can you paste the config? was kernel selection fixed or dynamic during the run?

jia: dynamic. we allow kernel switch for int8 paths. config:
```
micro_window_ms: 6
coalesce_delay_ms: 1.5
jitter_pct: 12
token_budget_target: 48
allow_kernel_switch: true
kv_prefill: enabled
```

morgan: 6ms micro window is on the low side for p99 if arrival variance spikes. jitter 12% seems... oddly high for small windows. what was qps distribution?

jia: overall steady 1200 qps but bursts to 3k in short spikes (10-30s). token length median 28, tail 400. p50/p95 fine, p99 jumps by ~80-180ms during bursts.

sam: are the p99s correlated with kernel swaps? kernel compile or transient relink can add 50-200ms depending on env.

jia: good call — profiler shows a handful of requests spent time in "kernel_selector::warmup" and "kv::evict_and_rehydrate" during the same windows.

alex: hmm kv evict+rehydrate + kernel warmup in same micro-window would definitely blow the fast path. Could be stochastic ordering due to jitter and coalescing hitting an unlucky request that triggers both.

morgan: suggestion: try two experiments — (A) lower jitter to 4% and introduce a small guard 
```
max_kernel_switch_per_sec: 0.2
kv_prefill_threshold: 0.6
```
and (B) bump micro_window_ms to 10 and reduce coalesce_delay_ms to 0.8. keep token_budget_target same.

jia: i can run both. curious whether raising micro_window reduces chance of overlap or just increases batching-induced latency for short responses.

sam: also add a latency-aware routing rule that forces kernel switch operations to a low-priority lane, or schedule warmups during low qps windows. even a simple token-leak throttle could stave off synchronized rehydrates.

infra-bot: deploy note: scheduled experiment A at 2026-05-03T18:20Z to eng-runtime-canary. resources: 2x g4dn-large. config path: /canaries/microwindow/2087654321-A.json :white_check_mark:

jia: running A now. will post p99 diff after 2h. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex: if A doesn't help try reducing token_budget_target to 32 for short trials; fewer tokens per batch might reduce tail amplification when kernel warmups happen.

jia: noted. if A looks promising will try B next and log traces for any kernel_switch events.

morgan: one more ask — include a short stacktrace for any requests that hit both "kernel_selector::warmup" and "kv::rehydrate". that's the smoking gun.

jia: will do. uploading traces in ~3h.
